name: Classic
why: 1, 2, 3, 4 is a run of 4. The order in the list does not matter.

name: Empty
why: No numbers, no run: 0. max() of an empty sequence raises ValueError; give it a default.

name: One number
why: A single number is a run of 1.

name: Repeats
why: Repeats do not make a run longer: 1, 2, 3 is 3. A set removes the repeats.

name: Two runs
why: -1, 0, 1 is 3 long; 3 to 9 is 7 long. The answer is 7.

name: 200,000 in one run
why: Count up only from a number x where x − 1 is not in the set: the start of a run. If you count up from every number, a run of 200,000 costs about 20 billion steps (O(n²)).

name: 200,000 scattered
why: With a set, each 'in' check is O(1) on average, so the whole job is O(n). sorted() is switched off, so sorting is not available.
